messages.text:
The old NerdOctAxe started reporting a hash rate of under 5.3TH and an effincy of nearly 40j per TH, so I turned off reported it to the seller (not HD by the way) and got a partial refund as it worked for 6 months or so. The fans were running fine though.

I was thinking of using the screen from the X1 but I thought if Hammer locked that it may be a waste of my time. So as the NerdOctAxe was basically scrap I thought I would try that display.

I have been checking temperatures on the BC04 and the ASIC is running at 58 to 59c while the VRM is alternating between 76 and 76.3c. The fan is on auto and runs just inder 90%.

Andrew T.
Handed to the team · No published VRM thermal limit for the BC04 in the product facts; JD should conf

Hi Andrew,

Smart call on the NerdOctaxe display. The X1 screen would most likely have been locked the same way the BC04's was, so you saved yourself the detour.

Your ASIC temperature looks comfortable. The V. sitting just over 76C with the fan on auto near 90% is the part worth watching, since that stage is usually the first to complain on these boards rather than the chip itself. Easy wins before anything else: more open space around the heatsink, cooler intake air, and a check that nothing is recirculating warm exhaust back into the fan. Also worth comparing your Harlo OS build against the latest release for the BC04 on harlolabs.com, since fan curves and VRM readings get tuned between versions.

I have asked JD on our side to give you the firm safe ceiling for that VRM and his view on the fan curve at 5.5 TH. He will come back to you in this thread. If you would like an answer sooner, he is very active on our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, posting there and mentioning @nullhashrate usually gets a quick reply.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

I have tweeked the setting down a bit. I see 5.4TH now the ASIC is about the same but the VRM is just under 75%. The fan is running at just under 80% now. The firmware is 0.2.101 and says it is the latest under settings. I am going to sleep now so no hurry on any answer as I am finewith 5.4 but 5.5 would be nice

Andrew T.

Hi Andrew,

That sounds like a good trade. Losing 0.1 TH to drop the VRM a degree and the fan ten points is the right side of that bargain, and it will be kinder to the board over a long run.

If you want the 5.5 back, take it out of the cooling rather than the settings. Cooler intake air, a bit more space around the unit and a clear exhaust path will let you put the clock back up without the VRM climbing. Pushing voltage to chase that last 0.1 TH is where these boards start getting hot, and anything that counts as an overclock also puts the unit outside warranty, so I would not go down that road.

On the firmware, if the settings page tells you 0.2.101 is current then that is the build to sit on. JD is still picking up your earlier question, and he will confirm the safe VRM ceiling and whether there is anything newer worth flashing. He will reply here. If you would rather catch him directly, he is on our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf as @nullhashrate.

Sleep well, nothing here needs an answer tonight.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
